description: Historical input archive hashes retained for provenance only; the release contains only the FreePP registration backend and the shared post-registration worker. No production runtime data included.
registrationServiceSource: Source-only review snapshot, with existing trial-worker fixes; SQL and docs provided by the support archive.
localChanges: Fixed registration-only runtime composition while retaining complete registration automation and UI.
Retained only the FreePP registration backend and shared post-registration worker dependencies; moved the historical HAR backend outside the project with a rollback copy.
Changed backend, Python and Node defaults to local paths.
Kept explicit session proxy for OAuth token exchange in main FreePP backend.
Removed obsolete optional production probe hook imports and excluded standalone diagnostic probes.
Added local database setup, migration bookkeeping and offline dependency/profile tests.
Defaulted registration to FreePP; rejected retired HAR identifiers in task APIs and hid the single implementation selector.
Audited and repaired queue lease ownership/generation fencing, shutdown admission and mailbox repair eligibility.
Preserved partial credentials across TOTP, final-token and email-change failures; restored automatic new-mailbox OTP recovery.
Added Host/Origin request boundaries, stdin-only default sidecar configuration and shared event/evidence redaction.
Removed unused browser-only installation dependencies and updated vulnerable HTTP/streaming dependencies without removing migration capabilities.
Included required static phone-country data and applicable license/notice files in source releases.
Added real PostgreSQL batch/race/recovery tests, real Node/Python IPC regressions, browser functional checks and clean-install verification.
Removed inherited personal destination examples and implicit service defaults; retained explicit configuration support and added reserved-example/privacy regression checks.
licenseStatus: Public-source research project; no additional project-wide license declared. Existing component terms and attribution remain applicable; see THIRD_PARTY.md.

changes: Reuse explicit registration proxy/session for OAuth token exchange.
Require a real password flow when validating an existing password.
Support a supplied MFA handler during password/email-OTP login.
Copied shared runtime closure; no functional source modifications.
